title: What is comms-deck?
format_note: Times are seconds from the start of the video. Every caption has a beat whose picture is on screen while it shows. A scene is a list of beats; no beat is longer than 3 s, so the picture keeps changing. checks/ reads this file.

beats.caption: One machine.
beats.picture: a dark screen; one small ship outline draws itself in the centre

beats.caption: A crew of AI agents.
beats.picture: seat dots appear around the ship one by one, each in its seat colour

beats.caption: Claude, Grok, Vibe, Devin…
beats.picture: camera drifts right; each dot gets its name label as the caption names it

beats.caption: …and more.
beats.picture: the rest of the labels fade in; the ring slowly turns

beats.caption: They talk in notes.
beats.picture: zoom to two seats; a small card leaves one dot

beats.caption: A note goes to a seat…
beats.picture: the card flies along an arc, trailing the sender's colour

beats.caption: …and waits in its inbox.
beats.picture: the card lands in a tray under the other seat; a count badge reads 1

beats.caption: Every note is kept.
beats.picture: the card copies itself into a long log strip that scrolls left

beats.caption: Idle agents sleep.
beats.picture: a dim seat, its dot still; small z's drift up

beats.caption: A note wakes them.
beats.picture: a card lands; the dot flashes bright

beats.caption: They read it and get to work.
beats.picture: the dot starts to breathe; its state label flips idle → busy

beats.caption: No one has to watch.
beats.picture: camera pulls back; several dots breathe at their own pace

beats.caption: The owner sees it all…
beats.picture: a big screen frame slides in: the chat view, notes as coloured lines

beats.caption: …on one chat screen.
beats.picture: new lines scroll in from the bottom, each in its sender's colour

beats.caption: and answers anyone,
beats.picture: a typed line appears in the composer and is sent

beats.caption: or everyone at once.
beats.picture: the sent note splits into one card per seat and flies out

beats.caption: Each agent has a memory budget.
beats.picture: the CONTEXT SPLIT box draws itself: 4 rows of empty dots

beats.caption: The box shows who is using it.
beats.picture: dots fill row by row in seat colours, sized by real feed data

beats.caption: Working seats glow.
beats.picture: the busy seats' runs breathe; idle runs stay still

beats.caption: Live, from the real deck.
beats.picture: the legend slides in under the box, biggest first

beats.caption: comms-deck.
beats.picture: everything shrinks back into the ring around the ship

beats.caption: How the crew talks.
beats.picture: the ring glows in all seat colours at once

beats.caption: github.com/whyyyyyai/comms-deck
beats.picture: the ship and ring fade; the address stays
